title: FileNode/copy skips @type validation that FileNode/set create enforces
description: crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/filenode.rs:1233 (merge_filenode_overrides) through 1615 (create_object). Commit 379d0c4b adds the -16 @type checks only to the /set create path (lines 305, 673-697): unsupported @type is rejected, and so are File without blobId and SymLink without target. The copy path deserializes the merged override and passes it straight to create_object with none of these checks. Scenario: a FileNode/copy entry {"id":"<dir>","@type":"Bogus"} creates a node with NodeType::Other("Bogus"); {"id":"<dir>","@type":"File"} creates a File with no blobId. Spec draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-16 §3.1.1: 'A server MUST reject the creation of a node with an @type that is not in the supportedNodeTypes capability with an invalidProperties error'. §3.2.4: copy has 'the same behaviour' and 'the same additional errors as FileNode/set'. Fix: move the type/consistency checks into a helper and call it from both paths. Related to JMAP-mrod.6 and JMAP-mrod.7 (both cover /set only).
close_reason: fixed in working tree (uncommitted), verified by adversarial reviewer + cargo test
